# Runbook: Orders API

Owner: orders-team

## Alerts
- **HighErrorRate** (2% / 5 min): 5xx above 2% of requests for 5 minutes
- **QueueBacklog** (oldest message > 600 s): OrderPlaced queue older than 10 minutes

## First 10 minutes
1. Acknowledge the alert and open an incident channel.
2. Check dashboards: https://grafana.example.com/d/orders
3. Confirm scope: which customers, regions and operations are affected.

## Diagnostics
1. Check the last deploy and compare error start time
2. Inspect DB connection pool metrics
3. Check payment provider status page

## Remediation
1. Roll back to the previous image if errors began at deploy time
2. Scale consumers if backlog grows with healthy errors
3. Enable the payment degraded mode flag

## Rollback
1. Deploy previous image tag
2. Verify /health and error ratio for 10 minutes

## Escalation
- After 15 min: page the orders on-call lead
- After 30 min: incident commander

## Verification
- Error rate and latency back to baseline for 15 minutes
- No growing backlog or retries
- Customer-facing confirmation where applicable

## After the incident
- Record timeline and open a postmortem (tool: postmortem)
- Update this runbook with what was missing
